children: Ardent Health revised 2025 Adjusted EBITDA down to $447.3 million and Adjusted EBITDAR down to $611.6 million after removing $97.7 million of prior non‑GAAP adjustments.
Removed $97.7M of aggregate non‑GAAP adjustments (Q3 2025) related to accounts receivable estimate and New Mexico professional liability accrual.
Adjusted EBITDA for year ended Dec 31, 2025 decreased from $545.0M to $447.3M as a result of the removals.
Adjusted EBITDAR for year ended Dec 31, 2025 decreased from $709.3M to $611.6M after the revisions.
Revisions do not change GAAP consolidated financial statements, net income (other periods), 2026 results, or cash flows.
Changes were made following discussions with the SEC staff; revised non‑GAAP supplemental disclosures attached as Exhibit 99.1.
